en.title: Bakery Quality Control
en.description:
Compare each pair consisting of a box item string box and a template string template. The order of characters does not matter, but the count of each item must match; return the number of mismatched boxes.

The input/output protocol and the limits marked as 'added by this site' were compiled by this site; limits not given in the original problem are not treated as part of the original source.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n lines, each containing two strings box and template that consist only of lowercase a-z and contain no spaces. 0≤n≤1000, and each string has length 1..10.
en.output: Output the number of mismatched pairs.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the algorithm idea, proof of correctness, and complexity.
